preview.diagram.noticeDrawn.comment: Limits-strip notice for the Diagram mode of a Markdown (or notebook) file with more than one Mermaid diagram fence. Plural key: the first argument (the number of diagram fences in the file) selects the plural category and is never printed. %2$@ is that number of fences, formatted for the display locale; %3$@ is the position, counting from one, of the fence that is drawn, also locale-formatted. Say that diagram number %3$@ of %2$@ is drawn; the other fences stay as code in the Rendered and Source views. Keep both placeholders and write the relation in words (the language's own 'of'), never as a slash, hyphen or fraction. One short sentence. All translations are drafts pending native-speaker review.

preview.diagram.noticeReadable.comment: Quiet note under a diagram that is too large to be shown whole with readable text. Formatted key, no count and no plural: %1$@ is the scale the diagram is drawn at, already formatted as a percentage for the display locale (for example 63%). The diagram is drawn at the smallest size that keeps its labels readable instead of shrinking further, and the reader moves to the rest by scrolling or dragging. Keep %1$@ exactly once. Two short sentences. All translations are drafts pending native-speaker review.
